recent.heading: RECENT PROJECTS
recent.empty_hint: Start with a New project or open one from disk.

keyboard.title: Stay keyboard-first
keyboard.body: G / R / S switch transform · F frames selection · ⌘K opens the command palette · ⌘E exports.

git.title: Designed for git
git.body: Each Node is its own JSON file. Drop the project folder into any repo — diffs are clean and reviewable.

ai_key.title: Bring your own AI key
ai_key.body: Local Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI. The desktop process proxies all calls — your key never reaches the renderer.
